brief.rules: Provider is Claude Code Cloud; never substitute Codex, an API model or a same-VM subagent for a cloud worker. Evidence goes in docs/work-specs/cicd-followup/evidence/phase-<id>.md, one file per phase. Follow the spec's Rules for every phase and its Measurement contract. Never weaken, skip or loosen a check, test, limit or budget, never write a test-maintenance entry or budget exception to pass a gate (the only exception: a dated extension under the spec's rule, at most 14 days past the original date and once per item), and never manufacture samples or filler work to meet a timing target. No arbitrary sleeps or added retries as a flake fix. The limited unrelated-failure exception applies only with independent attribution evidence and its tracking issue; pending, cancelled or missing results never qualify, and a failure in checks, selection, shared infrastructure or protection the phase changed stays blocking. Human operational ownership (miwco, weekly owner session backup) is distinct from agent coordination: never invent an owner. Bound each GitHub API collection pass to 100 calls, cache immutable run/job reads, and keep credentials and signed log URLs out of evidence. A JEV session may run beside this plan: before touching ci.yml, configured-suite, selectors/lists, helpers, Playwright configs, quarantine handling or locks, check open PRs and branches for overlap and report a conflict instead of racing it.
